organization.name: Spendesk
organization.notes: Founded 2016. Institutional funding verified by company Series C announcements; 2022 extension brought Tiger Global alongside existing backers. Funding announcement is historical; current cap table is not public. Blog updated in 2026 describes 2021 events and is not treated as a new 2026 round.

pricingTiers.name: Foundations
pricingTiers.notes: Fixed monthly platform fee plus usage fees for card purchases, invoice payments and expense claims. Unlimited users; request a quote; no numeric base amount published.
No explicit Most popular or Recommended designation verified on the official plan page; no plan inferred.

pricingTiers.name: Foundations with selected add-ons
pricingTiers.notes: Same organizational platform with procurement/AP/advanced workflows or multi-entity add-ons; tailored quote, not a separate Business plan.
No separately named Enterprise tier published; larger/multi-entity configurations use Foundations plus quoted add-ons.

moats.claim: Combining regulated payments, card controls and approval/accounting workflows can create switching costs across finance and employee spending processes.

productReasons.claim: Single-use, recurring and multi-use virtual cards let teams apply different controls to one-off purchases, subscriptions and projects.
OCR, receipt matching and reminders reduce the manual work of collecting purchase evidence.
Multi-entity controls and real-time budgets consolidate spending decisions across legal entities.
